node.title: Re: cpan client- install_base value not used to install Text::Table
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I'd suggest using [mod://local::lib], as that will take care of configuring the modules in a way that they should install cleanly to a local directory. Both [mod://cpan] and [mod://cpanm] can make use of [mod://local::lib]; I believe the former requires a bit of configuration (modern versions should ask you whether you want to use [mod://local::lib] on initial configuration), and [mod://cpanm] doesn't need any extra configuration; I'd recommend the latter.

Of course, you could just install an entire build of Perl locally using [http://perlbrew.pl|perlbrew].
